name: Rerank
description: Cross-encoder re-ranking for retrieval: choose a rerank provider and paste its API key. It stays off every existing retrieval path until a caller is wired to it.

ext.rerank.provider.title: Provider
ext.rerank.provider.description: Which vendor serves the rerank call. The endpoint comes with the choice, so nothing else needs filling in. Providers whose rerank needs a cloud login rather than a pasted key (Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, a self-hosted NVIDIA NIM) are not listed.

ext.rerank.model.title: Model
ext.rerank.model.description: Which of that provider's rerank models to call; the section offers the provider's own catalogue as a dropdown.

ext.rerank.apiKey.title: API key
ext.rerank.apiKey.description: Kept in the app vault; handed to the agent as an environment variable when a session starts, never written to a settings file. A key saved while a table is open is picked up by the next session, so reopen the table before testing it with /rerank:test.

settingsSections.title: Rerank
settingsSections.description: Provider, API key and model for cross-encoder re-ranking
